about.title: We're a group of foodies who love cooking and sharing.
about.imageAlt: Fresh ingredients on a kitchen table
about.value1Text: Every recipe is broken into clear, numbered steps with a tick-off ingredient list.
about.value2Text: Explore dishes from 28 cuisines — from Japanese teriyaki to Moroccan tagine.
about.value3Text: No fancy equipment needed. Just good food you can make in your own kitchen.
about.story1: We are the right place for anyone who loves cooking and wants to explore recipes from around the world. Our mission is to bring you the best dishes you can easily make at home — from mouth-watering appetizers to sweet desserts.
about.story2: With Tastebite, cooking becomes more fun and a lot less complicated. Start your culinary adventure with us and find new inspiration in every recipe.
